changelog: 🧠 Per-user category rules engine with exact/contains matching, hit telemetry, and isolated retroactive backfill.
🔒 Upgraded cryptographic exchange with secure dynamic IV generation on Android and backend.
🏗️ Refactored Web MVC controllers and singularized class names to meet PSR-4 patterns.
⚡ Standardized upload directory layout from txt_loot/ to uploads/payloads/.
📱 Android AppInfo screen now fetches server version and displays an update banner when behind.
🌐 Dynamic versioning API (/api/v1/system/version) serves changelog, version, and APK link.
📖 Setup guide corrected to match actual token generation and device linking flow.
🖱️ Analyze button now shows a confirmation modal explaining the rules engine before running.
🤖 Enhanced ML parsing metrics inside transaction completion emails.
